items.subject: How much protein you need to build muscle
items.hook_idea: كم غرامًا من البروتين تحتاج فعلًا لبناء العضل؟
claims: With resistance training, the benefit of extra protein levels off around 1.6 g per kg of body weight per day
seed_sources: Morton RW et al., Br J Sports Med, 2018 (meta-analysis)
items.note: Published early at the owner's request (planned for 20:00).

items.subject: Ab exercises do not burn belly fat
items.hook_idea: هل تمارين البطن تحرق دهون البطن؟
claims: Training one body part does not selectively reduce the fat over it
seed_sources: Vispute SS et al., J Strength Cond Res, 2011
Ramírez-Campillo R et al., J Strength Cond Res, 2013
items.note: Redone at the owner's request with the Jeddawi Echo voice; previous take kept in git history.

items.subject: Short sleep while dieting shifts loss from fat to muscle
items.hook_idea: قلة النوم قد تجعل خسارتك من العضل لا من الدهون
claims: In a small controlled study, dieters sleeping 5.5 hours lost less fat and more fat-free mass than at 8.5 hours
seed_sources: Nedeltcheva AV et al., Ann Intern Med, 2010

items.subject: Training each muscle twice a week
items.hook_idea: تمرين العضلة مرة في الأسبوع يكفي؟
claims: Training a muscle at least twice a week tends to build more muscle than once a week, especially when it adds weekly volume
seed_sources: Schoenfeld BJ et al., Sports Med, 2016
items.note: Made ahead on 2026-10-24 at the owner's request with his character 'The Blanket'; for 2026-10-26 20:00.

items.subject: Weekly sets for muscle growth
items.hook_idea: كم مجموعة أسبوعيًا تحتاج العضلة لتنمو؟
claims: More weekly sets per muscle are associated with more growth, with about 10 or more sets outperforming fewer
seed_sources: Schoenfeld BJ, Ogborn D, Krieger JW, J Sports Sci, 2017
items.note: Prepared on 2026-10-27 at the owner's request, ahead of the 2026-10-29 20:00 slot.

items.subject: Creatine: effective and safe for healthy people
items.hook_idea: الكرياتين: هل هو آمن ومفيد فعلًا؟
claims: Creatine monohydrate improves training adaptations and is considered safe for healthy people at recommended doses
seed_sources: Kreider RB et al., J Int Soc Sports Nutr, 2017 (ISSN position stand)
items.note: Owner's brief of 2026-10-21 (creatine: muscle or water?); owner-specified voice and ~60 s length.

items.subject: Intermittent fasting versus calorie restriction
items.hook_idea: الصيام المتقطع أفضل لخسارة الوزن؟
claims: In a 12-month randomized trial, time-restricted eating with calorie restriction was not better than calorie restriction alone
seed_sources: Liu D et al., N Engl J Med, 2022

items.subject: Low-carb versus low-fat
items.hook_idea: قليل الكربوهيدرات أم قليل الدهون؟
claims: In the 12-month DIETFITS trial, healthy low-fat and healthy low-carb diets led to similar weight loss
seed_sources: Gardner CD et al., JAMA, 2018

items.subject: Metabolism does not slow down after 30
items.hook_idea: هل يبطؤ حرقك بعد الثلاثين؟
claims: Adjusted for body size and composition, daily energy expenditure stays stable from about age 20 to 60
seed_sources: Pontzer H et al., Science, 2021

items.subject: Everyday movement outside the gym (NEAT)
items.hook_idea: حركتك اليومية خارج النادي قد تفرق أكثر مما تتوقع
claims: Non-exercise activity varies widely between people and helps explain differences in fat gain
seed_sources: Levine JA et al., Science, 1999
Levine JA et al., Science, 2005

items.subject: Water before meals
items.hook_idea: كوب ماء قبل الوجبة يساعد في خسارة الوزن؟
claims: In a 12-week trial in middle-aged and older adults, 500 ml of water before meals plus a diet led to more weight loss
seed_sources: Dennis EA et al., Obesity, 2010

items.subject: Liquid calories and sugary drinks
items.hook_idea: السعرات التي تشربها لا تشعرك بالشبع
claims: Sugar-sweetened drinks are associated with weight gain in adults and children
seed_sources: Malik VS et al., Am J Clin Nutr, 2013

items.subject: Light versus heavy weights for muscle
items.hook_idea: أوزان خفيفة أم ثقيلة لبناء العضل؟
claims: Light and heavy loads build similar muscle when sets end close to failure; heavy loads build more strength
seed_sources: Schoenfeld BJ et al., J Strength Cond Res, 2017

items.subject: You do not need to train to failure
items.hook_idea: لازم توصل للفشل العضلي في كل مجموعة؟
claims: Stopping sets close to failure is effective for muscle growth; reaching complete failure is not required
seed_sources: Refalo MC et al., Sports Med, 2023
Grgic J et al., J Sport Health Sci, 2022

items.subject: Rest between sets
items.hook_idea: كم ترتاح بين المجموعات؟
claims: In trained men, about 3 minutes of rest between sets led to more strength and muscle than 1 minute
seed_sources: Schoenfeld BJ et al., J Strength Cond Res, 2016

items.subject: The post-workout protein window
items.hook_idea: نافذة البروتين بعد التمرين: حقيقة أم مبالغة؟
claims: Total daily protein matters more than eating it immediately after training
seed_sources: Schoenfeld BJ, Aragon AA, Krieger JW, J Int Soc Sports Nutr, 2013

items.subject: Diet breaks
items.hook_idea: الاستراحة من الرجيم قد تحسّن النتيجة
claims: In one trial in men with obesity, alternating two weeks of dieting with two-week breaks led to more fat loss than continuous dieting
seed_sources: Byrne NM et al., Int J Obes, 2018 (MATADOR)

items.subject: Weighing yourself regularly
items.hook_idea: وزن نفسك بانتظام: مفيد أم مقلق؟
claims: Regular self-weighing is associated with better weight loss and maintenance; if it causes anxiety, weigh less often
seed_sources: Zheng Y et al., Obesity, 2015 (systematic review)

items.subject: Muscle memory after a break
items.hook_idea: توقفت عن التمرين؟ عضلاتك تتذكر
claims: Previously trained muscle tends to regain size faster after a training break
seed_sources: Seaborne RA et al., Sci Rep, 2018
Psilander N et al., J Appl Physiol, 2019

items.subject: Does cardio kill muscle gains?
items.hook_idea: هل الكارديو يقتل العضل؟
claims: Combining endurance and strength training interferes little with muscle growth for most people; high running volume matters most
seed_sources: Wilson JM et al., J Strength Cond Res, 2012
Schumann M et al., Sports Med, 2022
